source: Miami-Dade County, Better Bus Network route-by-route guide (Nov 13, 2023)

routes.2: Made shorter in the Nov 2023 bus redesign.
routes.3: Path changed in Nov 2023. Part of its old path is now covered by route 75.
routes.7: Path changed in Nov 2023. Some weekday rush-hour trips (7A) start at the Airport station.
routes.8: Made longer in Nov 2023. The old 8A branch was cut.
routes.9: Path changed in Nov 2023, and a new 9A branch was added.
routes.11: Path changed in Nov 2023. Some old stretches are now covered by free MetroConnect rides.
routes.12: No change in the Nov 2023 redesign.
routes.15: Used to be route A. Made longer and renumbered in Nov 2023.
routes.17: Made longer in Nov 2023, and a new 17A branch was added.
routes.21: No change in the Nov 2023 redesign.
routes.22: Made shorter in Nov 2023. Routes 17 and 75 cover part of its old path.
routes.24: Made shorter in Nov 2023 (it used to be the Coral Way Limited).
routes.26: Used to be route B. Made shorter and renumbered in 2023.
routes.36: Path changed in Nov 2023. The 36B branch was cut.
routes.75: Made longer in Nov 2023, and a new 75A branch was added.
routes.77: Same path after Nov 2023. It also replaced the old 277 NW 7th Avenue MAX.
routes.97: Used to be route 1. New number, same path.
routes.100: Used to be the 120 Beach MAX. Path changed in Nov 2023.
routes.203: Used to be the 93 Biscayne MAX. New number, same path.
routes.207: Little Havana Connection. No route change in Nov 2023.
routes.208: Little Havana Connection. No route change in Nov 2023.
routes.211: Heads up: 211 used to be the Overtown Circulator. Since Nov 2023, 211 is the Flagler MAX (the old route 51), weekday rush hours only.
routes.279: Used to be the 79 Street MAX. New number, same path.
routes.400: Overnight bus. Used to be the 500 Midnight Owl. New number, same path.
routes.401: Overnight bus. Used to be the 246 Night Owl. New number, same path.
routes.836: Express bus, renamed 836 Express Dolphin Park & Ride in 2023.
routes.837: Express bus to Tamiami Park & Ride. Renamed in 2023.

overtown.instead: Use routes 2, 7, 9, or 77, or book a free MetroConnect ride.
Use route 77, or book a free MetroConnect ride.

downtown.route: 95 Express to Broward (Broward Blvd and Sheridan St)
downtown.instead: These express trips to Broward were discontinued. The 95 Golden Glades Express still runs.

little-havana.instead: Use route 8, 24, or 211, or book a free MetroConnect ride.
